title: TaskIntent
description: Declarative, all-optional description of what the caller wants. MUST be the input to dispatch() and dispatch_intent().

description.description: Free-text description of the task. SHOULD be concise.

system_prompt.description: System prompt for the LLM window. MAY be omitted; CRP provides no default.

task_input.description: The user-facing input to process. MUST pass structural validation (§22.3.1).

expected_output_type.description: Hint for extraction pipeline. MAY be omitted.

max_windows.description: Maximum windows for this task (including continuations). MAY be omitted for unbounded.

max_output_tokens.description: Per-window generation reserve. MUST NOT exceed the model's maximum output length.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata. MUST NOT exceed 50 keys.
